hero.tagline: Where academic inquiry meets real-world child welfare impact
hero.description: Empowering students, researchers, and agencies to work together in advancing child welfare practices and policies through meaningful partnerships, shared data, and evidence-based solutions globally.

directory.title: Connect with the Right People
directory.description: Our directory brings together students, researchers, and agencies from around the globe, making it easy to find the perfect collaboration partners.
directory.studentsDesc: Browse profiles of MSW and PhD students actively seeking research opportunities. Learn about their academic backgrounds, interests, and availability for collaboration.
directory.researchersDesc: Discover university-affiliated researchers working on child welfare topics. View their publications, current studies, and areas of expertise.
directory.agenciesDesc: Connect with child welfare and nonprofit organizations from around the world. Each profile includes mission statements, service areas, and collaboration interests.

collaboration.title: Find Your Perfect
collaboration.description: Our collaboration portal makes it easy to connect with like-minded researchers, students, and agencies who share your passion for improving child welfare outcomes.
collaboration.postBrowseDesc: Submit your research questions or browse existing ones. Filter by topic, region, or population to find relevant opportunities.
collaboration.smartMatchDesc: Our intelligent matching system connects you with collaborators based on shared interests, data needs, and geographic location.
collaboration.forumsDesc: Join discussions on key issues in child welfare. Share insights, ask questions, and build partnerships in thematic forums.
collaboration.globalNetworkDesc: Connect with partners worldwide, from local community organizations to international child protection agencies.
collaboration.joinResearchers: Join 1,000+ researchers and practitioners in ongoing discussions

dataTools.title: Access the Data You Need
dataTools.description: Curated datasets, validated assessment tools, and comprehensive ethics guidance to support your research journey.
dataTools.dataSourcesDesc: Access curated datasets from federal agencies, international organizations, and nonprofits.
dataTools.assessmentToolsDesc: Explore validated tools used in child welfare assessments and research studies.
dataTools.irbEthicsDesc: Navigate ethical requirements with comprehensive guides for domestic and international research.
dataTools.trendsDesc: Stay updated on policy changes, funding priorities, and practice innovations

resources.title: Grow Your Expertise
resources.description: Access professional development resources designed to strengthen your research skills and expand your knowledge in child welfare.
resources.workshopsDesc: Live and recorded sessions on research design, data analysis, grant writing, and more.
resources.toolkitsDesc: Downloadable guides for building partnerships and implementing evidence-based practices.
resources.readingListsDesc: Curated essential readings from foundational texts to recent journal articles.
resources.showcaseDesc: Share your work with the community. Highlight your projects, publications, and reports to inspire collaboration and celebrate innovation.

events.upcomingEventsDesc: Join conferences, networking events, and workshops to connect with the child welfare community.
events.grantsDesc: Discover funding opportunities for students, researchers, and agencies to support child welfare initiatives.
events.grantWritingDesc: Access proposal templates, budget guides, and sample successful applications.

contact.title: We're Here to Help
contact.description: Have questions or need assistance? Our team is ready to support your research journey.
contact.subject: Subject
contact.messagePlaceholder: Tell us how we can help...
contact.faq1a: Create an account by clicking 'Get Started' and completing your profile. Once approved by our administrators, you'll have full access to all features including the directory, collaboration tools, and data repository.
contact.faq2q: How do I access research data?
contact.faq2a: Navigate to the Data & Tools section to browse available datasets. Some data requires registration and IRB approval. Each dataset includes information about access requirements and data sharing policies.
contact.faq3a: IRB requirements vary by institution and research type. Visit our IRB & Ethics Guidance section for comprehensive guides on U.S. state processes, university submissions, and international ethics standards.
contact.faq4a: Yes! ImpactLink is a global platform welcoming researchers from around the world. Our directory includes agencies and researchers from multiple countries, and we provide resources for international collaboration.
contact.newsletter: Subscribe to our newsletter for the latest research opportunities, events, and resources.

footer.tagline: Bridging the gap between academic research and real-world child welfare application.
